item.title: Shoujo Ningyou ~Ai to Shiiku no Hibi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Puchi Devil
  • 発売日: 2002-08-30
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 少女人形～愛と飼育の日々～
  • 英語名: Shoujo Ningyou Ai to Shiiku no Hibi

あらすじ

One day, our hero happens to cause an accident and a girl loses her memory. Afraid of the situation going public, he takes her to his house and hides her in his room. This is how they begin living together.

There is only way for her to regain her memory: sleep with her and make her cum! Will our hero be successful in helping the girl retrieve her memory?

item.title: Inbi no Makoku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Puchi Devil
  • 発売日: 2001-04-20
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫美ノ魔刻
  • 英語名: Inbi no Makoku

别名

  • Inbi no Makoku

あらすじ

This game has its setting on an island in the Far East, where the North and South are divided in war. The player becomes the commander of an intelligence unit called Makoku, who invades the

enemy country to save his girlfriend, Nanayo. You, Mitsuru, promote all the beautiful women under your command to “Lust Sergeants” and train them to become lustful dolls. These lust sergeants then go out and sleep with the enemy, looking for any weaknesses there may be. You, then go in and assassinate them.
